aic_from_rss — DRIVE ball op

• Data kinds: none → scalar (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.aic_from_rss(rss: 'float', n: 'int', k: 'int') -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import ballistics; ballistics.aic_from_rss(rss: 'float', n: 'int', k: 'int') -> 'float'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("aic_from_rss"))

Usage

Akaike information criterion from a least-squares residual sum of squares: AIC = n ln(RSS/n) + 2k (Gaussian noise, variance estimated by maximum likelihood, constant term dropped). Only differences between models fitted to the same data are meaningful (the absolute value depends on scale and n). n ≤ k, RSS ≤ 0 and non-finite values raise ValueError (RSS = 0 is AIC = −∞ and the model-selection question does not arise).
